blurb: Treasure Hill Farm is a full care equestrian facility in Southeastern CT offering inside and outside boarding with premium hay and amenities. They have indoor and outdoor arenas, a cross country course with various jumps, and several miles of trails. They host schooling and rated horse shows and offer arena and cross country schooling rentals.
